newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 16.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Discussions continuing on enlarging Ivory Coast government to bring in the opposition, President Henri Konan Bedie says.
- Yamoussoukro is symbol of our unity, says Information Minister Daniel Boni Claverie on why Bedie and his ministers held a cabinet meeting in the interior political capital.
- There are vast business opportunities in Africa, African Development Bank head tells U.S. business mission during visit to the bank's Abidjan headquarters.
- French companies project more investment in Africa, says report by lobby of French companies in Africa.
- Americans assess business opportunities in Ivory Coast; More than 40 investors on business mission since January 12.
